items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: And he'd take another band and get a trumpet player and send with me.

ctx.x: Who did he send in this place?

Well he'd pick up just who he could get, what he could, somebody he could cheat. See, he'd take, he'd take that job, he'd be done, got, I'd be done, get him a deposit on a job, you know. And he'd take another job, you see. And he'd take another band and get a trumpet player and send with me. Sometimes he'd send a good one, sometimes he'd just send somebody not used to playing with the band. Well that's what got me disgusted.
Did y'all ever make any records with Chris? No, no. And who was in the rhythm section with Chris?
